newsitem.title: UK: Michael Jackson flies into UK with sore throat.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson flies into UK with sore throat.

text.p: Pop superstar Michael Jackson flew into Britain on Thursday apparently suffering from a sore throat.
Jackson, wearing a black hat, black cloth mask and black military style uniform, arrived on a Concorde supersonic airliner at London's Heathrow airport from New York.
He indicated he was unable to speak by pointing at his throat. When asked by reporters if he was pleased to be in Britain, he nodded his head.
When asked if he had any message for his fans, Jackson brought his hands together as if he was praying that they would wish him well.
The star, backed by burly minders, then left for an undisclosed destination in an executive mini-bus.
Jackson is not scheduled to perform in Britain and the purpose of his visit was not known.
